item.title: Heavy Rain Warning Issued With Risk Of Flooding And Travel Disruption
item.description: The unsettled weather is expected to bring outbreaks of rain, heavy at times, before clearing to heavy showers later on Tuesday.

item.title: Two Door Cinema Club, Ash And Joel Corry Added To Isle Of Wight Festival 2026 Line-Up
item.description: Sky Presents the Isle of Wight Festival has revealed the next wave of acts set to perform in 2026.

item.title: Hedgelaying Competition Returns To The Isle Of Wight
item.description: The Isle of Wight Hedgerow Group has confirmed its annual hedgelaying competition will return in 2026 after a two-year break.

item.title: Questions Raised Over Disclosure of Councillor’s Rental Properties
item.description: Concerns were raised at County Hall this week over the handling of the disclosure of an Isle of Wight councillor’s rental properties.

item.title: Top Five Crossovers That Confused Everyone
item.description: Crossovers are meant to be fun. A treat. A little wink to the audience. item.title: Five Brilliant Brain Teasers For The Week (Winter Mysteries Edition)
item.description: Snowy scenes, chilling clues, and logical reveals. Wrap up warm and see if you can crack these frosty puzzles before the solutions! 1) The Frozen Lake (Easy) A man walks across a frozen lake every morning to get to work. One day, halfway across, he turns back immediately and returns home — unharmed. item.title: HGV Diversions To Increase As Brading Road Closure Forces Traffic Through Villages
item.description: Island Roads is due to begin works at Elenor’s Grove, between Fishbourne and Ryde, with the scheme expected to last around three months.

item.title: Former Totland School Site Could Deliver 16 ‘High-Quality’ New Homes
item.description: A former Isle of Wight school site could be redeveloped to provide 16 ‘high-quality’ new homes.

item.title: Free Cowes Parking Boost For Daisy Ring Bus Volunteer Drivers
item.description: Volunteer drivers for Daisy Ring Bus C.I.C. can now benefit from free parking in Cowes, thanks to the support of Northwood House Charitable Trust Co Ltd.

item.title: Council Tax Support To Remain Unchanged For Low-Income Isle Of Wight Residents
item.description: Isle of Wight residents on low incomes will continue to receive the same level of help with their council tax bills, despite annual increases in the charge.
